login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Quick sign-in, then back to the lab bench.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? The tournament staff can give you a reset link.

register.title: Register
register.subtitle: One account, one partner, ten cups. The experimental setup is simple, the result hopefully significant.
register.footer: Non-alcoholic drinks are explicitly welcome. We only count cups, not blood alcohol.
register.displayNameHint: This is how you appear in your team and on the scoreboard.
register.emailHint: Only used to sign in. Never shown publicly.
register.passwordHintRemaining: At least {min} characters ({remaining} to go). A sentence works great.
register.eventCodeHint: It's on the invitation or at the entrance.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password. The link only works once and is valid for 30 minutes.
reset.done: New password saved. All old sessions have been ended.
reset.linkUnusable: This link is invalid, expired or has already been used. Ask the tournament staff for a new one.

profile.title: Profile
profile.mustChangeBody: Your account uses a temporary password. Please set your own now before you continue.
profile.changePasswordNote: After the change you will be signed out on all other devices.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

home.preparingBody: The tournament staff are mixing the reagents. Check back soon.
home.forbidden: You don't have permission to view that page. You were redirected to the home page.

team.lockedBanner: Teams are locked. Changes only via the tournament staff.
team.signupSoonBody: The tournament staff will open team registration shortly. Go grab your lab partner!
team.noTeamBody: You're not in a team. Contact the tournament staff if this is a mistake.

create.title: Create a team
create.subtitle: You'll get an invite code for your duo.
create.mottoPlaceholder: Precise down to the last cup
create.created: Team created! Now invite your partner.

invite.title: Invite your partner

invite.rotated: New code generated. The old code no longer works.

leave.lastMember: You're the last member: if you leave, the team is dissolved and the name becomes free again.
leave.otherStays: Your partner stays in the team and can invite someone new.
